//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Zombie Horse Spawn -> Config

Enable Zombie Horse Spawn.//: Whether Zombie Horse Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceSurfaceZombieHasHorse.//: The chance a zombie that has spawned on the surface is riding a horse. min: 0, max: 1

shouldBurnZombieHorsesInDaylight.//: If enabled, burns zombie horses when daylight shines upon them.

onlySpawnZombieHorsesOnSurface.//: If enabled, a zombie horse with rider will only spawn on the surface.
